端点必须是有限十进制数字: Endpoints must be finite decimal numbers
区间逆序或为空: The interval is reversed or empty
集合最多包含 256 个区间或点: A set supports up to 256 intervals or points
并集缺少集合: A union is missing a set
请使用有界区间、点集或 or 并集: Use bounded intervals, finite point sets, or an or union
集合跨度必须有限: The set span must be finite
值域须为有限闭区间或单点: The range must be a finite closed interval or a single point
单点定义域必须对应单点值域: A single-point domain requires a single-point range
值域是增量贡献范围，例如 [-20,0] 或 {5}；单点值域可省略曲线。: The range defines an additive contribution, e.g. [-20,0] or {5}. A single-point range can omit the curve.
支持区间、单点和并集，例如 [0,300] or [600,999) or {5: Supports intervals, points and unions, e.g. [0,300] or [600,999) or {500}. Outside the domain there is no contribution this frame. All segments share global bounds; false / true map to 0 / 1.
非单点值域必须指定曲线。: A nonconstant range requires a curve.

按数组顺序求值，多个效果的输出贡献相加；输入不在定义域内时，该资产当帧不贡献效果: Evaluate in array order and add output contributions. An asset contributes nothing this frame when the input is outside its domain. An empty array contributes no effects.

使用水平速度方向，仅适用于水平角。速度低于 10 cm/s 时保持已有方向；首次: Uses horizontal velocity for Yaw only. Below 10 cm/s, keeps the previous direction. If initially stationary, uses the owner rotation until valid motion or a reset.
使用空间速度方向，世界 +Z 为向上方向。速度低于 10 cm/s，或与向上方向: Uses spatial velocity with world +Z as up. Below 10 cm/s, or parallel to up, keeps the previous direction. If initially invalid, uses the owner rotation until valid motion or a reset.

归一化误差经响应曲线映射到此速率区间，再进行指数平滑；速率越大，追随越快。推进时: The response curve maps normalized error into this rate interval for exponential smoothing. Higher rates follow faster. When time advances, a zero effective rate snaps to the target.
限制当前值与目标值的剩余差距。位置和距离使用 cm，旋转和视场角使用度，其余使用: Limits the remaining difference from the target. Position and distance use cm; rotation and FOV use degrees; other channels use their own units. Rotation lag is at most 180°. When time advances, zero lag snaps to the target.
仅开始时固定本次过渡的参考与目标；每帧会随参考对象重新计算目标值。: At start only fixes the reference and target for this transition; Every frame recalculates the target from the reference object.

靠近范围中值时使用。倍率必须全域大于零，避免无法返回；默认恒为 1。: Used when moving toward the range midpoint. Gain must remain positive throughout to allow return. Defaults to 1.
